schema.related: groups of signed dimension tokens that say nearly the same thing; only one member of a group may be a dominant or secondary signal, so the design is not built on one pleasure counted three times
schema.axis_keyed: per signed axis token: the central fantasy and the core verb it implies, used when it outweighs every weight-keyed entry in implications.json
schema.callbacks: transformed echoes of the night. when: a condition on the night; from: what the bearer did; becomes: what it is in the game (a design requirement); vision: the Proprietor's line. Placeholders: {companion} {attempted} {thread} {wearing} {moment}
schema.unrequested: features the player never asked for that follow from a behaviour; the first whose condition holds is used, so the most particular behaviours come first
schema.facts: plain recollections used when the night produced fewer than three remembered moments
schema.addresses: what the Proprietor says as the deck is squared, when no model writes the reading
schema.last_card: narration after the pronouncement: the deck becomes the one card that is the build prompt
schema.handoff_line: the Proprietor's last words, spoken over that card; the prompt itself follows, outside the fiction
schema.weight_visions: the Proprietor's line for a weight whose design rule in implications.json has none
schema.when: conditions: always; companion (bool); attempted (bool); joker (kept|played|spent); inventory (substring); thread (bool); threads (minimum count, open or resolved); flag (name); failures (minimum); signal (universal signal id seen at least once); moment (bool); matches_min; matches_max

callbacks.card: The Thing the House Could Not Do
callbacks.from: tried something the house could only half allow: "{attempted}"
callbacks.becomes: what the house could only half allow is fully possible in the game, and the game is built so that it matters
callbacks.vision: You asked the house for something it could not quite do. There will be a place where it can.

callbacks.becomes: a small companion of the same nature, which the player may keep or lose, and which reacts to what they do
callbacks.vision: I see {companion} again, a little changed, keeping pace with you. It has opinions about where you go.

callbacks.from: put on the {wearing} and kept it on
callbacks.becomes: the player character wears it, and the world addresses them by it
callbacks.vision: You will be wearing the {wearing}. They will address you by it, and you will let them.

callbacks.from: carried a seedling up through the house and kept it warm
callbacks.becomes: something small that grows only if tended across the whole game, and is visibly larger at the end
callbacks.vision: Something small will come with you from the first room. By the last it will be taller than you are.

callbacks.from: played the Joker and said what would happen
callbacks.becomes: a rare power that rewrites the situation completely, offered early and never refilled
callbacks.vision: Once, you will say what happens, and it will. I see you choosing the moment more carefully than you did tonight.

callbacks.from: untied the ribbon on a deck tagged DO NOT SHUFFLE
callbacks.becomes: a rule stated on the first screen that the game quietly rewards breaking
callbacks.vision: The first thing the game tells you not to do, you will do. It is counting on that.

callbacks.from: failed at something, and went back
callbacks.becomes: failed attempts stay visible in the world as marks that teach the next attempt
callbacks.vision: Where you fall, a mark stays. I see a floor of them, and the last one is not a fall.

callbacks.becomes: the most rewarding optional place in the game sits behind something that looks like what the player walked past
callbacks.vision: The thing you walked past is still there. In the game to come, it is where the best of it is kept.

callbacks.from: carried a doorknob belonging to no door
callbacks.becomes: an object with no stated use that opens the one thing nothing else opens
callbacks.vision: There will be a door with no handle. You already have the handle.

callbacks.from: kept the Joker unplayed to the end of the night
callbacks.becomes: one single-use power the game never forces the player to spend, and an ending that notices if it is still unspent
callbacks.vision: You will be handed one thing that can be used once. I see it still in your hand at the end, and the ending knows.

callbacks.becomes: the first situation of the game restages this moment and lets the player answer it again
callbacks.vision: The game opens on something you have already done tonight. You will know it when you see it.

unrequested.follows_from: jammed the lever so that nothing had to be given up

unrequested.feature: The player can name things, and the game uses the names from then on.

unrequested.feature: Passes, stamps and forms exist in the game, and the player can issue their own.

unrequested.feature: Somewhere in the game its own rules are written out in full, for anyone who goes looking.

unrequested.feature: Every game of chance in the game can be inspected, and the inspection always finds something.

unrequested.feature: The game counts its doors, and says so when the last one has been opened.

facts.text: You did not come up alone.
You fell, and came back up.
You carried a doorknob all night, and it never met its door.
You walked past something, and it is still where you left it.
You came up with every match you were given, or more.
You came all the way up.

solve.spatial: I see a room that is its own puzzle, and you solving it with your feet.
solve.execution: You will get it clean, once, and want it clean every time after.
solve.pattern: I see something moving in a pattern, and you counting under your breath.
solve.deduction: There will be three things that cannot all be true. You will know which is lying.
solve.linguistic: There will be a rule, written down. You will read it more carefully than whoever wrote it.
solve.experimentation: I see two things that were never meant to touch, and you touching them together.
solve.social: Someone will stand in your way, and you will learn what they want before you learn their name.
solve.optimization: I see a number, and a better number, and you not resting between them.
conflict.avoidance: I see something large and watchful, and you already on the far side of it.
conflict.negotiation: There will be a thing in your way that no one has ever thought to ask. You will ask.
conflict.manipulation: I see two things that want the same door, and you introducing them.
conflict.direct: There will be a door that expects you to knock. You will not knock.
conflict.tactical: I see you arranging a room before the trouble arrives, and the trouble arriving exactly where you left room for it.
conflict.chaotic: I see a tidy room. I see you. I do not see the tidy room for long.
soc.recurring: Someone you meet in the first room will be in the last, and will remember what you did.
soc.factions: I see two sides, each certain you are theirs.
soc.simulation: I see people keeping their own hours, and you learning them.
soc.crowds: There will be one loud, crowded room, and you will stay in it longer than you need to.
soc.competition: I see someone a half-step ahead of you, glancing back.
soc.cooperation: There will be a thing that takes two pairs of hands. The second pair is not yours.

addresses: You thought you were carrying these somewhere. You were not. You were making them. Every card was blank when it left my counter. Look at them now.
The errand was never the deck. A deck carries nothing. It keeps what its bearer does on the way up, and you have been doing things all night.
They were blank when I gave them to you. I did not put these faces on them, and the house did not. Sit still. This will not take long.

blank_card.text: Some of these are still blank. I will not pretend to read them. Whoever builds for you may fill them as they please.

last_card: The Proprietor gathers the cards into one, the way water gathers, and turns it face up on the baize. It is covered from edge to edge in small exact handwriting, and none of it is addressed to you.
handoff_line: It is not built yet. This one is for whoever builds for you: they will not know the house, and they will know what this says. Take it to them. Then go and find out whether I was right.
